intro: Team meeting drill. You're presenting your plan to cut delivery times. Marcus tends to interrupt. Hold your ground calmly: acknowledge him, keep control, and finish your point. Start by giving your first point.

rounds.speaker: marcus
rounds.text: Sorry, sorry, before you go on, we tried that last year and it flopped.

rounds.speaker: marcus
rounds.text: Yeah but who's paying for this? Can we just skip to the budget?

rounds.speaker: marcus
rounds.text: Honestly I think we're overcomplicating this whole thing.

rubric.label: Acknowledged the interruption
rubric.tip: Briefly acknowledge first, like 'Fair point, Marcus.' That takes the heat out.

rubric.label: Kept control and redirected
rubric.tip: Hold your spot: 'Let me finish this point, then I'll cover the budget.'

rubric.label: Stayed concise (under 35 words)
rubric.tip: Short answers sound composed. Rambling sounds defensive.

penalties.label: Hostile tone
penalties.tip: Stay calm. Hostility loses the room even when you're right.
